F2 (MEDIUM) src/serve.ts:177-190 metrics listener has no bearer or host check unlike src/http.ts:9-29, and src/metrics.ts:74-131 issues per-worker and per-dispatch SQL: 50ms at 200 retained workers, 731ms at 1000, 5125ms at 3000. F3 (MEDIUM) src/http.ts:34-52 with src/security.ts:43-50 and 5-23: /events replay 1981ms and 1986ms at 1000 retained workers.
